name: Daily Mail Router — Email Triage & Auto-Reply System
description: A webhook-driven router that receives pre-classified email events (from a paired Gmail-monitoring workflow) and routes them by tier: FYI-only 'summary' emails post a Telegram notification; 'reply_approval' emails are staged in an n8n Data Table and sent to Telegram with inline Approve/Reject buttons — approving triggers an instant Gmail reply with the AI-drafted response, then cleans up the pending record.

nodes.name: Router Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives POSTs with {tier, from, subject, summary, draftBody, messageId, threadId, ...} from the paired mail-classification workflow

nodes.name: Send Summary Notification
nodes.notes: FYI-only branch — posts sender, subject, AI summary, and any action-needed note

nodes.name: Store Pending Approval
nodes.notes: Stages the drafted reply (thread ID, from address, Gmail message ID, subject, draft body) in an n8n Data Table pending human approval

nodes.name: Send Approval Request
nodes.notes: Sends the summary + drafted reply with inline '✅ Send Reply' / '❌ Reject' buttons, callback_data keyed to the thread ID

nodes.name: Lookup Pending Approval
nodes.notes: Retrieves the staged draft by thread ID from the callback data

nodes.name: Send Reply Email
nodes.notes: Sends the drafted reply to the original sender only

nodes.name: Edit Message + Cleanup (Approved / Rejected)
nodes.notes: Updates the Telegram message to show the outcome (buttons removed) and deletes the pending row either way

companion_workflows: Official Email Workflow → Telegram — classifies incoming official-inbox mail and posts it to this router.
Personal Email Workflow → Telegram — same triage pattern for the personal inbox.
meta.security_note: The webhook is currently configured with no authentication. For a self-hosted n8n instance exposed to the internet, this endpoint should be protected with a header-auth credential or IP allowlist.
